raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`--enable-unified-cache-external-linker` failed at startup on MiniMax-M3.1: the MiniMax sparse strategy had no direct-linker pool group.

## Modifications

- `_MiniMaxSparseStrategy.build_direct_linker_pool_group` builds three entries over the M3.1 NVFP4 pools:
  - `KV`: one main-KV page row per layer (NVFP4 K/V payloads and block scales).
  - `INDEXER`: one index-K page row per sparse layer (payload and scales), addressed by the KV page.
  - `DRAFT`: the DSpark / DFlash draft KV, reusing the sidecar draft entry from the FULL + MAMBA path (factored into `_sidecar_draft_entries`).
- bf16 MiniMax sparse pools, HiSparse and packed draft KV are rejected with an explicit error.

## Accuracy Tests

MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, 4x GB300, TP4, DSpark, Balanced cookbook recipe + Mooncake linker. Per prompt (9000 tokens, 96 greedy tokens): device prefix hit vs. L3-only hit after `/flush_cache`, with the load targets poisoned before every load.

| arm | L3 hit tokens | output ids equal | max \|Δlogprob\| | spec_verify_ct equal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| this PR | 8960 / 8960 | 2/2 | 0.0 | 2/2 |
| skip KV load | 8960 / 8960 | 0/2 | 7.51 | 0/2 |
| skip INDEXER load | 8960 / 8960 | 0/2 | 4.93 | 0/2 |
| skip DRAFT load | 8960 / 8960 | 2/2 | 0.0 | 0/2 |

Device hit vs. device hit is bit-exact as well (max |Δlogprob| 0.0), so any difference above comes from the restore. Without poisoning, the PR arm also matches on 4/4 prompts.

Unit: `test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_linker_pool_assembler.py`.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

**Nothing blocking.** The comments below are optional suggestions. There is no need to push a fix for them before merging.

<!-- bhrv:4f31ece86f26fb03 -->

🟡 (optional) When a sidecar draft pool has more layers than the local main KV pool, its extra layers are never transferred or are rejected. `num_layers` is fixed to `main_pool.layer_num` at linker_pool_assembler.py:636. The `DRAFT` entry maps draft layer i to transfer layer i for every `range(draft_pool.layer_num)`. The Mamba builder this code was split from sizes the group with `max(layer_mapping)+1` so draft layers are always covered. Fix: compute the group size from the largest layer key across all entries (as `_build_mamba_device_pool_group` does), or reject `draft_pool.layer_num > main_pool.layer_num` with a clear error.

<details>
<summary>Why this was flagged</summary>

The trigger needs a sidecar draft pool (DSpark/DFlash) whose `layer_num` is larger than the stage-local `main_pool.layer_num`. That can happen with pipeline parallelism, where `main_pool.layer_num` counts only the stage's own layers. `_sidecar_draft_entries` (linker_pool_assembler.py:576) maps draft layers `0..draft_pool.layer_num-1` onto transfer layers. The new builder still passes `DevicePoolGroup(entries, main_pool.layer_num, page_size)` at :636. In that case `MooncakeDirectLinker` loops only over `range(self.num_layers)` (mooncake_direct_linker.py:261/334), so the higher draft layers are never saved or restored. A restore then leaves stale draft KV, so speculative acceptance diverges without any error. `UMBPDirectLinker` checks `0 <= layer < self.num_layers` (umbp_direct_linker.py:188) and fails at startup instead. The FULL + MAMBA path avoids this by sizing with `max(...) + 1` at :560.

**Verification:** nit. Trigger: a sidecar DSpark draft pool with more layers than the stage-local MiniMax NVFP4 main pool, possible with PP>1 DSpark in PD prefill (speculative_hook.py:716-721). The new builder fixes the group size at main_pool.layer_num (linker_pool_assembler.py:636). Mooncake never loads draft layers beyond it (mooncake_direct_linker.py:334), and UMBP fails at startup (umbp_direct_linker.py:187-198).

</details>

<!-- bhfn:1:nit -->

+    def test_minimax_m31_nvfp4_maps_page_rows_and_draft(self):
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import MHATokenToKVPool
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.minimax_m3_nvfp4_pool import (
+            MiniMaxM3Nvfp4IndexKPool,
+            MiniMaxM3Nvfp4KVPool,
+            MiniMaxM3Nvfp4MainKVPool,
+        )
+
+        def page_rows(pool_cls, row_bytes):
+            pool = pool_cls.__new__(pool_cls)
+            pool.page_size, pool.layer_num = 2, 2
+            pool.rows = [torch.zeros((4, row_bytes), dtype=torch.uint8)] * 2
+            return pool
+
+        kvcache = MiniMaxM3Nvfp4KVPool.__new__(MiniMaxM3Nvfp4KVPool)
+        kvcache.start_layer, kvcache.layer_num = 4, 2
+        kvcache.main_pool = page_rows(MiniMaxM3Nvfp4MainKVPool, 5)
+        kvcache.index_k_pool = page_rows(MiniMaxM3Nvfp4IndexKPool, 3)
+        kvcache.index_k_layer_id_mapping = {4: 0, 5: 1}
+        draft = MHATokenToKVPool.__new__(MHATokenToKVPool)
+        draft.page_size, draft.layer_num = 2, 1
+        draft.k_scale_buffer = draft.native_k_scale_buffer = None
+        draft.k_buffer = [torch.zeros((8, 7), dtype=torch.uint8)]
+        draft.v_buffer = [torch.zeros((8, 7), dtype=torch.uint8)]
+        params = SimpleNamespace(
+            mtp_draft_device_pools=(), sidecar_draft_device_pools=(draft,)
+        )
+
+        def resolve():
+            return resolve_hybrid_device_pool_group(
+                kvcache=kvcache,
+                page_size=2,
+                params=params,
+                components={ComponentType.FULL},
+            )
+
+        group = resolve()
+        self.assertEqual(group.num_layers, 2)
+        self.assertFalse(group.rank_replicated)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            group.sources,
+            {
+                PoolName.KV: PoolName.KV,
+                PoolName.INDEXER: PoolName.KV,
+                PoolName.DRAFT: PoolName.KV,
+            },
+        )
+        indices = torch.tensor([2, 3, 6, 7])
+        for name, row_bytes in ((PoolName.KV, 5), (PoolName.INDEXER, 3)):
+            entry = group.entry_map[name]
+            self.assertEqual(entry.layer_mapping, {0: 0, 1: 1})
+            locations = entry.prepare_locations(indices)
+            self.assertEqual(locations, [1, 3])
+            _, sizes, offsets = entry.get_prepared_layer_range_meta(locations, 1)
+            self.assertEqual(sizes, [[row_bytes]] * 2)
+            self.assertEqual(offsets, [[row_bytes]] * 2)
+        draft_entry = group.entry_map[PoolName.DRAFT]
+        self.assertEqual(draft_entry.layer_mapping, {0: (0, 1)})
+        self.assertEqual(draft_entry.prepare_locations(indices), [2, 6])
+
+        params.mtp_draft_device_pools = (object(),)
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "M3.1 NVFP4"):
+            resolve()
+        params.mtp_draft_device_pools = ()
+        kvcache.main_pool = page_rows(MHATokenToKVPool, 5)
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "M3.1 NVFP4"):
+            resolve()
